title: Jacob and Esau Reconcile

questions.question: How did Esau greet Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:4 (ESV): "But Esau ran to meet him and embraced him and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept."

questions.question: What did Jacob offer Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:10-11: Jacob urged Esau to accept his gift of livestock.

questions.question: Where did Jacob settle after meeting Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:17: Jacob journeyed to Succoth and built a house there.

questions.question: Did Jacob and Esau reconcile peacefully?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:4: Esau ran to meet Jacob, embraced him, and they wept together.

questions.question: What did Jacob buy near Shechem?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:19: Jacob bought a piece of land from the sons of Hamor.

questions.question: How many men were with Esau when he came to meet Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:1: Esau was coming with four hundred men.

questions.question: How did Jacob arrange his family when meeting Esau?
options: Servants first, Rachel and Joseph last
questions.correctAnswer: Servants first, Rachel and Joseph last
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:2: Jacob put the servants first, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph last.

questions.question: What did Jacob do as he approached Esau?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:3: Jacob went on before them, bowing himself to the ground seven times.

questions.question: What did Esau offer to do for Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:12: Esau said, "Let us journey on our way, and I will go ahead of you."

questions.question: What did Jacob say about seeing Esau's face?
options: It was like seeing the face of God
It reminded him of their father
questions.correctAnswer: It was like seeing the face of God
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:10: "for I have seen your face, which is like seeing the face of God."

questions.question: Why did Jacob decline to travel with Esau?
options: The children were frail and the flocks needed care
He wanted to go to Bethel
questions.correctAnswer: The children were frail and the flocks needed care
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:13: Jacob said the children are frail and the nursing flocks needed gentle driving.

questions.question: What does "Succoth" mean?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:17: Jacob built booths for his livestock, so the place was called Succoth (booths).

questions.question: How much did Jacob pay for the land near Shechem?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:19: He bought it for a hundred pieces of money.

questions.question: What did Jacob name the altar he built near Shechem?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:20: Jacob erected an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel (God, the God of Israel).

questions.question: Where did Esau return to after meeting Jacob?
questions.explanation: Genesis 33:16: Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

key_verse_text: But Esau ran to meet him and embraced him and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.
